newsitem.title: FINLAND: PI-CONSULTING SEES 1997 PROFITABILITY SLIGHTLY UP.
newsitem.headline: PI-CONSULTING SEES 1997 PROFITABILITY SLIGHTLY UP.

text.p: Finnish consulting group PI-Consulting Oy said on Monday it expected profitability to improve slightly in 1997.
The company said it did not expect the market situation to change markedly this year but domestic demand would fall while there would be growth in exports.
"Group profitability is expected to improve slightly," it said in a statement with its 1996 results.
In 1996, the group posted a 7.4 million markka profit before extraordinary items, and its 18.7 million operating margin represented 10.9 percent of 171.2 million markka net sales.
